newsitem.title: UK: DHL hopes to fly cargo into Sarajevo by end of June.
newsitem.headline: DHL hopes to fly cargo into Sarajevo by end of June.

text.p: By the end of June express carrier firms should be able to fly cargo direct to Sarajevo instead of having to truck it from Zagreb, DHL's country manager for Bosnia-Herzegovina Edin Emso told Reuters.
Talking by telephone from Sarajevo, Emso said business so far this year is running 10 percent up on 1996 levels.

"DHL is projecting at least 100 percent growth for 1997 year on year. We have been in great demand from businesses and aid organisations in the region, as there is no other safe and reliable method of transporting documents and goods," Emso said in a statement.
DHL which opened its Sarajevo office in 1984 and also was the last air express carrier to close before the war.
Emso said it remains the only one to have so far to have reopened although he expects traditional competitors to soon resume business.
Recent DHL business has been mixed featuring computers and computer parts for assembly. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
